note:
PARTIAL GT: 466x657 poster. Boxes measured by connected-component segmentation of each line cropped separately (white-on-black body at threshold 140, red-on-black headline at 30 and 45, both agreeing within 1px). Annotated at LINE level, which is how the poster is actually set.

This file was first annotated at WORD level, and that was a mistake worth recording: the detector, when constrained by the scene pre-pass, emits only fragments of these lines, and I fitted the ground truth to those fragments. Unconstrained it reads 'mémoire des luttes contre' and 'crimes coloniaux et esclavagistes' as whole lines at 0.90+ confidence -- correct text that word-level boxes score as a total miss. The annotation was hiding the very improvement it existed to measure.

The two red horizontal rules under the headline (54,100,373,4) and (110,167,261,5) are graphics, not text, and are deliberately absent. Marked partial: the photograph in the middle contains a small blue-bordered notice around (78,285)-(138,313) whose text is below transcribable resolution.
